profile.headline: Software Engineer
profile.summary:
I'm a Software Engineer with more than 9 years of professional software development experience.
 
Designs and builds applications with a proficiency in backend API development and data modeling.
Proficient in Java 17, Kotlin, Spring, web development, and Object Oriented Design.
Converts business ideas and concepts into software services or products.

Inspired by our growing dependence on digital technologies, I decided to pursue a bachelors degree in Computer Science where I learned about algorithms, time complexity, and how to solve problems using C and Java.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
● Implemented a decrypting solution that required integrating secrets management, templating, and Spring web framework libraries while following existing enterprise standards
● Refactored acceptance integration tests to simplify the wording which would allow non-technical stakeholders to contribute
● Succeeded in upgrading application to a higher testing maturity to satisfy enterprise requirement
● Created an API attribute inventory spreadsheet to track the usage and help manage the migration of downstream data fields

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Backend Web app developer building the company's SaaS B2B risk and compliance (GRC) management solution.

- Led more than 4 feature initiative projects from requirements gathering to implementation, testing, and release
- Advocated for quality and maintainable code through strong participation in code reviews, refactors, and engineering discussions
- Implemented +20 REST HTTP API endpoints using the MVC design pattern allowing users to run CRUD operations on various resources 
- Implemented a custom query builder that gave a 6X speed up over using ORM framework code
- Integrated our app with external 3rd party cloud services and APIs such as AWS and Google Cloud Platform (GCP) allowing users to automate file downloads
- Used the pub-sub model and RabbitMQ (message broker) to integrate service apps in a distributed system architecture
- Solved complex concurrency and asynchronous event problems to improve the resilience of our apps

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Web app developer using the Agile framework to build SaaS CRM & portfolio management solutions for financial customers. 

- Specialized in backend development using Java and frameworks such as Spring, JSP, and Stripes
- Built an ETL (Exchange, Transform, and Load) Java Spring app to extract Oracle data into MongoDB for analytical queries
- Learned the pub-sub model to integrate Java microservices using RabbitMQ
- Solved complex concurrency problems and advocated for thread safety to improve the reliability and scalability of our applications

volunteerExperiences.description: I was a 1-1 tutor for English literacy and math.

projects.title: Haunted Building Text-Based Game (Visual C#)
projects.description: CS 440 Coding Project. The Haunted Building is a a text-based game written in C#. It is a horror, puzzle, travel game where the player is trapped in a building and the goal is to escape as soon as possible while avoiding monsters.

projects.title: Pharmacy Inventory Manager Program (Java)
projects.description: Final project for CS 342 Software Design. Create an inventory manager to keep track of medicine stock and notify user when expiration date is approaching or when stock is low.
